blocks.title: Contingent liabilities
blocks.text: Claims not acknowledged as debt: ₹9,218 crore at 31 March 2026, ₹4,553 crore a year earlier. That is 49% of FY26 profit. These are claims made on the company that it has not accepted as owed.

questions: Claims not acknowledged as debt rose from ₹4,553 crore to ₹9,218 crore in the year. What was added?
